problems.scientific_expression: The old composition did not make the cost multiplication explicit; the new figure separates one MD force request from a complete five-stage, 19-iteration SCF loop.
problems.geometry: The first rebuild squeezed full words into elliptical nodes; the final MD and SCF loops use true circular nodes with symbols inside and labels outside.
problems.annotations: The first video preview overlapped the right-panel heading with the density label; the redundant heading was removed and safety bands were rerun.
problems.readability: The dimer and density were initially too small; both now occupy the central panel at one fixed asymmetric camera, with force and motion arrows shown in separate phases.
problems.submission_quality: The A4 static figure and 17 s 16:9 video are independently composed, and all 408 frames are audited.

review.action: accepted after rebuilding both loops, enlarging the true 3D density scene, separating force and motion phases, and passing strict static plus every-frame QA
